### Paul’s Longing to See the Thessalonians
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/pauls-longing-to-see-thessalonians
Passage: 1 Thessalonians 2:17-18
Points:
- True conversion to Christ transforms believers from indifference to genuine affection for God's people.
- Christian love naturally craves personal, face-to-face communion rather than merely relating from a distance.
- Paul's forced departure and blocked return demonstrate that Satan actively seeks to hinder Christian fellowship.
- Believers must make intentional efforts to gather in person to build each other up and persevere in faith.

### You Are My Joy: The Deep Reward in Discipling Others
Author: David Mathis
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/you-are-my-joy
Passage: 1 Thessalonians 2:19-20
Points:
- Pouring into others through long-term discipleship involves substantial hardship, effort, and sacrifice.
- Describing spiritual disciples as our hope, glory, and joy does not compete with devotion to Christ.
- The spiritual maturity and perseverance of others serves as an outward expression and completion of our joy in God.
- Authentic joy in Jesus expands by sharing our own souls to draw other people into His grace.
